entities.summary: Nikolas Carlyle Turley is an American professional baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball for the Minnesota Twins and Pittsburgh Pirates, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp and Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles.
